summary: Iteration 22 — Critical Alerts entitlement verification for v1.0.8. All 27 pytest checks pass in 0.52s. Verified: (1) app.json expo.version=='1.0.8', ios.entitlements has BOTH 'aps-environment':'production' AND 'com.apple.developer.usernotifications.critical-alerts':true, ios.bundleIdentifier=='com.paulvincenti.quakeguard', expo-notifications plugin still {mode:'production'}. (2) reminders.ts has allowCriticalAlerts:true (no stale :false), interruptionLevel:'critical' (no stale 'timeSensitive'), sound:'default' preserved. (3) push.ts has allowCriticalAlerts:true. (4) server.py send_push data in /api/trigger-alert now includes '"interruption_level": "critical"' AND '"sound": {"critical": 1, "name": "default", "volume": 1.0}' alongside title/message/action_url. (5) POST /api/trigger-alert with X-Admin-Token:Pt3481pt → 200 JSON with {status,recipients,push_delivered,push_error}; POST without token → 401; wrong token → 401. (6) send_push helper interface unchanged (still enforces title+message keys). (7) Regression: /api/status GET+POST OK, /api/register-push upserts (201-or-500 tolerated because EMERGENT_PUSH_KEY=placeholder), /api/admin/purge-test-devices POST/GET behave as before, all 6 debug endpoints still 404. (8) Frontend E2E on https://quake-alert-18.preview.emergentagent.com @390x844: Home renders with trigger-alert-btn → tap opens /alert with EARTHQUAKE DETECTED (M6.4 / 12km / VII) and im-safe-btn → tap I'M SAFE → auto-navigation back to Home confirmed. TS compile of reminders.ts and push.ts clean. Backend lint clean. Critical-alerts OS-level bypass behaviour is untestable on web/Playwright (device-only), which matches the agent-to-agent context note.

minor.issue: Still returns 500 in this env because EMERGENT_PUSH_KEY=placeholder (relay 401 -> HTTPException(500)). DB upsert still lands first, so no data loss, but callers cannot distinguish 'never saved' from 'saved but relay unavailable'. Same as iteration_21.

ui_bugs.issue: After auto-nav from /alert back to Home the DOM contains TWO elements with data-testid='trigger-alert-btn' (Playwright strict-mode violation). Likely a lingering RN-Web mount from the previous route. Not related to critical-alerts change; pre-existing regression noise only visible via multi-match selectors. UI itself renders correctly (screenshot confirms single visible button).

action_items: (Optional, carried over from iter_21) Make POST /api/register-push return 201 even when the Emergent relay is unavailable, since the local DB write already succeeded.

(Optional, low-priority) Investigate why two data-testid='trigger-alert-btn' nodes coexist in the DOM after auto-nav from /alert back to Home. On device this is harmless (RN native only mounts the active screen), but it breaks strict-mode Playwright selectors. Consider .first() usage in future tests or ensure /alert route unmounts fully.
